summary: Planning-only split of I01e2 into two pending B1 children: actual-image Compose topology and fresh/retained lifecycle tooling; fail-closed independent-scenario reset and simultaneous separate Testcontainers isolation. I01e2 remains in-progress with its unchanged outcome/checks for combined qualification after both children. No runtime/build/UI/runner inputs changed, services/devices started or acceptance/review/release gates marked passed.
selectionReason: The clean master checkout matches startCommit and is active/authorized under D-304 with no findings or due group review. I01e2 is the earliest eligible pending implementation child: I01a/I01b/I01c/I01e1 are implemented. The real image/migration/health and now qualified synthetic HTTP/SMTP/admin interfaces exist, but no Compose topology or complete-environment lifecycle/reset controller exists. Fresh resource ownership, measured Docker29/WSL endpoint isolation and retained restart form a coherent deliverable with their own real-runtime checks; destructive independent-scenario replacement/failure handling and concurrent Testcontainers qualification are a second. Splitting before coding bounds these two outcomes without deferring all tests, dropping the parent integration obligation or skipping to I01f/accounts.

children.I01e2a: Test-only real-image Compose topology and owned host provision/wait/retained-restart/redacted-capture/targeted-cleanup CLI, with actual runtime/configuration/failure/retention/endpoint-isolation and unrelated-resource checks. New empty instances only; no implicit destructive reset.
children.I01e2b: Explicit fail-closed independent-scenario reset added to that CLI, whole-producer quiescence and empty baseline, twice-repeated and failure-then-reset checks, simultaneous separate real Testcontainers qualification, retained-restart regressions and complete I01f command/endpoint handoff.

planning.dependencies: I01e2a inherits I01e2's implemented prerequisites I01a/I01b/I01c/I01e1; I01e2b explicitly depends on I01e2a. No child depends on its open ancestor or I01f. After both children a fresh I01e2 parent unit executes all unchanged combined checks before closing I01e2. I01e then independently qualifies its two original children together; I01f still requires completed I01e/I01d and owns actual Android reachability/storage/Appium qualification. I01 combined qualification still precedes I02. No existing dependency, task outcome/check or batch assignment is changed.
planning.reviewBoundary: Both children inherit B1, which stays pending with its original full-capability review obligation. Independent review remains after I01-I04 and all descendants, not after each lifecycle/reset child. Findings, review anchors/coverage, authorization/model/permissions and external release gates are unchanged; activeRun remains null.
coverage: I01e2a owns the real application image and separate same-image migrate executable, pinned PostgreSQL and existing adapter image. Record exact Compose/tool/image/input identities and normal schema/writer/source/mailbox readiness, never a fake backend or a service that silently migrates. A failed fresh migration/startup/readiness must fail setup even before reusable reset is introduced.

I01e2a qualifies host endpoints and network isolation before device handoff. Existing server image tests document Docker29 suppressing published ports on internal networks; the adapter requires device-facing art origins and private admin/SMTP. A fresh implementing session must measure a compatible isolated Compose/host route rather than assume internal publication works or silently permit external provider/relay traffic. Actual Android routing remains I01f, not this planning unit or host HTTP success.

I01e2a's documented fresh provision accepts only a new owned empty instance. Retained service/DB/adapter restart must preserve foundation state/epoch, selected editions and synthetic captured deliveries without reset. Ownership checks and cleanup cannot reuse/delete another instance or Testcontainers state; local image/build caches may be retained. Commands must own all containers/networks/volumes/ports/temporary secrets and collect redacted evidence before targeted cleanup, including failures.

I01e2b owns explicit independent-scenario reset, which first invalidates the ready handoff and quiesces/removes old backend and adapter producers/connections before mutable-state replacement. Adapter generation-fenced reset alone cannot prevent an old backend opening a new SMTP connection. Reapply normal migrations and check empty implemented stores/deliveries, pinned source editions/configuration and fresh readiness. Repeat twice and after an induced failure; controlled reset/migration/readiness failure must not leave a usable dirty ready descriptor.

I01e2b supplies the simultaneous real PostgreSQL Testcontainers isolation experiment: keep separate retained sentinel/data/connectivity alive while Compose resets/cleans, and prove both owners' targeted cleanup cannot collide. Lower-layer test-owned mutable probes/synthetic SMTP are infrastructure diagnostics, never injected game/account/request acceptance state. Rerun in-scenario retention so adding reset cannot erase recovery checkpoints.

No account/game/inbox/outbox/mail/push worker exists beyond ownership scheduler/singleton recovery. Future workers/stores must join readiness/quiescence/reset/cleanup when implemented; no fabricated recovery result or new SMTP requirement is added to the foundation backend. No initialization helper is needed now; later helpers remain limited to validated users/saved decks before a scenario, never contacts/invitations/Ready/games/history/actions or mid-scenario mutation.

I01e2's original three checks remain verbatim, including both resets, failed-setup refusal, real retained restart, source/backend/private-admin isolation, concurrent Testcontainers and exact cleanup. I01e's original three combined checks also remain unchanged. Fresh Android app-data reset between independent tests, normal APK storage instrumentation and Appium/device execution stay I01f. Full feature/store/worker reset and T-551/T-630/T-662 acceptance remain pending through owning features/I34/I35; host infrastructure evidence is not whole-scenario acceptance.
